evidence.claim: Inspected the accepted target-state specification as a scoped requirements owner.
Inspected the general human-owner intent, including the external-skill open choice.
Checked owner-hierarchy and external-skill policy routing in exact repository sources.
Verified the checkout was clean and located exact policy markers stating that external-skill vendoring and related policy remain unresolved and cannot be silently decided.
Captured exact excerpts for the governing policy, reviewed-intent open choice, and owner hierarchy.

items.command: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n -i --hidden --glob '"'! .git/**'"' 'vendor|vendoring|third-party|agent skill|per-bundle|bundle decision|skill bundle' AGENTS.md .agents docs aria_nbv scripts pyproject.toml Makefile 2>/dev/null | head -240"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n -i --hidden --glob '"'! .git/**'"' 'bundle|bundles|third.party|third party|agent skill|skill(s)? should|allowlist|allowlisted|vendor' .omx .agents docs AGENTS.md aria_nbv/AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null | head -300"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "find .agents/skills -maxdepth 2 -type f -name SKILL.md -print | sort | sed -n '1,160p'; git diff --stat; git status --porcelain=v1"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "set -o pipefail
printf '%s\\n' '--- worktree ---'
git status --porcelain=v1
if git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet && test -z \""'$(git status --porcelain=v1)"; then
  echo CLEAN
else
  echo DIRTY
  exit 1
fi
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- governing decision markers ---'
rg -n -F -e 'Which external skills should be referenced, allowlisted, or vendored.' -e 'Do not vendor or reimplement maintained external capabilities without a measured gap, an explicit owner, and a smaller justified maintenance surface.' -e 'Any external-skill pin, allowlist, vendoring policy, or recursive integrity check requires a dedicated decision and evidence package.' -e 'Exact external-skill reference, allowlist, pinning, vendoring, and integrity policy.' -e 'resolving an open decision without the specified evidence or human choice' .omx/specs/deep-interview-aria-nbv-agent-scaffold-target-state.md .agents/references/human_owner_intent.md
printf '%s\\n' '--- accepted-spec metadata ---'
sed -n '1,12p' .omx/specs/deep-interview-aria-nbv-agent-scaffold-target-state.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- exact policy excerpts ---'
nl -ba .omx/specs/deep-interview-aria-nbv-agent-scaffold-target-state.md | sed -n '548,570p;820,867p'
printf '%s\\n' '--- reviewed-intent open choice ---'
nl -ba .agents/references/human_owner_intent.md | sed -n '168,186p'
printf '%s\\n' '--- owner hierarchy excerpt ---'
nl -ba .agents/skills/aria-nbv-context/SKILL.md | sed -n '1,42p'"
